labelled_by: independent reviewer (model: claude, labelling subagent without access to Arbiter output)

defects.justification: rooms.computeIfAbsent creates a Room (with up to 50 retained messages of 2000 chars) for every new name, there is no cap on rooms per client or in total, and rooms are never removed even when empty, so one unauthenticated client can grow the map without bound by joining endless unique room names.

Broadcast calls the blocking ctx.send for every member while holding the room monitor (and each Client monitor); one slow or stalled receiver blocks the sender's thread and every other post, join and /rooms listing for that room.
member.send is not wrapped in try/catch; if a member's session has closed but onClose has not yet removed it, the send throws and aborts the loop, so the remaining members silently miss the message.

join trims the room name (line 75) but message does not (line 76), so a client that joined with "general " is stored in "general" yet its messages addressed to "general " are rejected as 'not in room'.
testRuntimeOnly 'org.junit.platform:junit-platform-launcher' declares no version and no BOM/platform is imported, so its resolved version is not pinned in this manifest.
